scope: Mac custom-kernel microbenchmarks only; no iPhone measurements or iPhone performance conclusions.

method.configuration: Release Xcode macOS arm64 package tests, MLX GPU
method.order: 8 ABBA rounds; 16 samples per variant after 3 warmup samples per variant
method.timing: Prebuilt dependency-chain evaluation plus GPU completion, divided by 32; includes MLX dispatch; excludes graph construction; not GPU-only time

experiments.name: Frequency alpha precomputation
experiments.exact_checks: Bitwise FP32 output equality against the frozen bdf56d1 optimized kernel and the current inline path, across seven batch/length/channel cases including silence, extreme softplus deltas, adjacent SIMD channels and partially full groups; finite outputs required.
experiments.decision: Rejected: 17.0% slower on this Mac microbenchmark.

experiments.name: Temporal SIMD16 with ordered leader accumulation
experiments.exact_checks: Bitwise FP32 recurrent-state and output equality against frozen 2446c83 over eight successive updates in each of seven batch/channel cases, including silence and extreme softplus deltas; finite state and outputs required.
experiments.decision: Rejected: 4.88 times the current mean latency on this Mac microbenchmark.

shipping_changes: Both production kernels and the original frequency test restored to 2446c83; experimental temporal test removed.
